metadata.description: This card will simulate the beloved improv game Emotional Rollercoaster by offering players a randomized location + emotion/event. Players will then take these prompts and act out whatever crazy scenarios pop into their heads. As you play, the given emotion/scenario will change and players will need to match the new emotion and continue the scene. Tracks with image icons are easier for younger players (quicker emotion changes), while tracks with a "ha ha" icon have 2 minutes between each change.
